classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Design a protein sequence with NADPHX epimerase activity, ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity, ATP binding, and Mg(2+)-dependent metal ion binding, catalyzing epimerization of S- and R-forms of NAD(P)HX in the nicotinamide nucleotide metabolic process.
assumptions: The target protein belongs to the NAXE/NADHX epimerase family (e.g., human NAXE or bacterial homologs), which is well-represented in UniProt with reviewed entries annotated under GO:0036374 (NAD(P)HX epimerase activity).
Mg(2+) coordination is intrinsic to the catalytic mechanism of this enzyme family and will be present in retrieved family sequences without requiring explicit structure-guided metal placement.
AMP and (6S)-NADPHX binding site accessibility is a conserved structural feature of this family; a representative retrieved sequence is expected to encode this binding geometry.

No target structure or hotspot residues were provided; the workflow will retrieve family sequences via literature-grounded GO annotation and return the top reviewed representative as the output candidate.
The user requests a single output protein sequence; the sequence_analysis summary will identify the highest-quality reviewed UniProt entry from the family FASTA as the returned candidate.
ATP binding and ADP-dependent dehydratase annotations co-occur with NADPHX epimerase activity in bifunctional NAXE homologs; GO term retrieval will capture sequences annotated for these activities.
Temporal cutoff is not applied; the full reviewed UniProt corpus for this GO term is used to maximize coverage of experimentally characterized homologs.
Provider selected a workflow template by reference; expanded it to the validated local workflow descriptor.

params.query: NADPHX epimerase NAD(P)HX epimerization nicotinamide nucleotide metabolism Mg2+ magnesium AMP NADPHX binding ADP-dependent dehydratase

workflow_plan.name: semantic_constraint_to_family_sequences
workflow_plan.description: Retrieve literature for a semantic goal, extract a GO term, collect matching sequences, and summarize the family FASTA.

success_criteria.output_sequence: A single FASTA protein sequence from a reviewed UniProt entry annotated with NADPHX epimerase activity (GO:0036374), metal ion binding (Mg2+), and nicotinamide nucleotide metabolic process, selected as the top representative from the retrieved family set.
success_criteria.family_summary: Sequence analysis report covering composition, charge, conserved motifs, and Mg2+/AMP/NADPHX-relevant residue annotations for the retrieved family FASTA.
success_criteria.literature_evidence: At least one PMC/PubMed record grounding the GO term extraction and confirming NADPHX epimerization mechanism and Mg2+ requirement.
